name: olaclick
description: Connect ChatGPT to your OlaClick restaurant: orders, menu, products, clients, promotions and sales reports.

interface.longDescription:
OlaClick for ChatGPT lets restaurant owners and managers run their restaurant from chat: check orders and sales, manage the menu and promotions, and create orders, using their OlaClick data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

OlaClick is the all-in-one platform restaurants use to sell and operate: online ordering, menu management, delivery logistics, clients and promotions.

Connect your OlaClick account and ask ChatGPT to:
- Show today's orders and their status, or look up a specific order
- Create a takeaway, delivery or on-site order
- Find out which products sold the most this week
- Add or update products, variants and categories in your menu
- List clients, active promotions, payment methods and store status
- Manage promotions (coupons) and webhooks

How it works: you sign in with your OlaClick panel account and authorize the connector for the branch you are signed in to. Only Admin or Manager users can authorize. Access is scoped to the permissions you approve, tokens are short-lived and refreshed automatically, and you can revoke the connector at any time from the OlaClick panel.

Write actions (create order, create product, apply a coupon, record a payment) are annotated as writes, and irreversible ones (cancel an order, delete a promotion or a webhook) as destructive, so ChatGPT can apply its own safeguards before running them. Recording a payment registers a payment already collected at the restaurant; the connector does not process cards or move money.

Requirements: an OlaClick account with Admin or Manager role.
Documentation: https://developers.olaclick.app/docs/mcp
defaultPrompt: Show me today's orders and their status.
Which products sold the most this week?
Which promotions are active right now?
